intro: Crown of the Earth is a pivotal step in the Dolanaar quest chain investigating the ailments plaguing Teldrassil. Corithras Moonrage tasks adventurers with gathering water from the sacred moonwell in the Oracle Glade, using the journey to reveal the troubling truth behind the World Tree's creation.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: All was not well with Teldrassil, however. Staghelm's carefully made plans for the new World Tree had borne out as he had hoped, but there was one small problem, a problem to which many of the troubles on Teldrassil may be attributed.

However, I will not get into that yet. You must visit the last moonwell, to the northwest in the Oracle Glade. Under the boughs of the Oracle Tree lies the first and most powerful of our wells. Retrieve a phial of its water and return to me.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Along with the druids, the Oracle Tree and the Arch Druid have been carefully monitoring the growth of Teldrassil. But though we have a new home, our immortal lives have not been restored.

clips.title: Completion
paras: To be in the presence of the Oracle Tree... It is almost to feel wisdom take form. Let me continue the telling...

With Teldrassil grown, the Arch Druid approached the dragons for their blessings, as the dragons had placed upon Nordrassil in ancient times. But Nozdormu, Lord of Time, refused to give his blessing, chiding the druid for his arrogance. In agreement with Nozdormu, Alexstrasza also refused Staghelm, and without her blessing, Teldrassil's growth has been flawed and unpredictable...
